_comment: The browsers the installer offers (Yggdrasil's installer shows id, name, note, chosen; labyrinth-install-system installs them). packages: from the repositories (those already on the medium need no network); flatpak: from Flathub. desktop: the launcher names to look for when making it the default (the first one found).

browsers.name: Vivaldi
browsers.note: Chromium-based, very customisable: tabs, panels, mail and calendar built in

browsers.name: Firefox
browsers.note: Mozilla's browser: independent engine, many extensions

browsers.name: Brave
browsers.note: Chromium-based, blocks ads and trackers by default

browsers.name: LibreWolf
browsers.note: Firefox without telemetry, privacy settings turned up, uBlock Origin included

browsers.name: Mullvad Browser
browsers.note: Tor Browser's anti-tracking, for use with a VPN instead of Tor

browsers.name: Opera
browsers.note: Chromium-based, built-in browser VPN and ad blocker (from Flathub)

browsers.name: Opera GX
browsers.note: Opera for gamers: CPU, memory and network limits, Twitch and Discord (from Flathub)
